verdict.rationale: Kong documents a first-party "Kong Konnect MCP Server" at developer.konghq.com/konnect-platform/konnect-mcp/, and a probe confirmed that page exists. That gives agents an official MCP server to connect to, though the pack contains only the page title, not its contents. Kong's MCP autogeneration and MCP traffic-gateway features build or proxy MCP servers for users' own APIs, so they are a different capability and are not credited here. missing for 10: details of the exposed tools/capabilities, setup and authentication instructions for connecting an agent, supported clients, independent or hands-on corroboration.
